articles.title: Kota Shock: Man Detained Over Viral Death Threat to Rahul Gandhi, 25 Congress MPs
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kota (Rajasthan): A man has been detained by police in Kota after a video surfaced on social media in which he allegedly threatened to shoot Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi and 25 Members of Parliament from the Indian National Congress.

body.html:
Kota (Rajasthan): A man has been detained by police in Kota after a video surfaced on social media in which he allegedly threatened to shoot Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi and 25 Members of Parliament from the Indian National Congress.

The accused, identified as Raj Singh, reportedly issued a 24-hour ultimatum in the video, demanding the arrest of certain Congress MPs over alleged remarks against Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla during the recent Budget Session. He allegedly warned of violent action, including entering homes and shooting, if his demands were not met.

Following the circulation of the video, Kota Police detained the man for questioning. Officials confirmed that the authenticity of the video is being verified and that the accused’s background, including previous criminal cases, is under investigation. Police have assured that appropriate legal action will be taken based on the findings.

Background

The controversy stems from recent tensions in Parliament, where ruling party members alleged that Congress MPs made objectionable remarks against the Speaker. The Congress has denied these claims, stating that available footage does not support the allegations.

Political Reactions

The Congress strongly condemned the threat. Senior party leaders described it as a serious matter affecting democratic functioning and called for strict action. They also raised concerns about what they termed as an increasingly hostile political environment.

Leaders of the Bharatiya Janata Party distanced themselves from the accused, stating that he has no connection with the party and that such threats are against democratic values. Representatives of other organisations reportedly linked to the accused also denied any association with his statements.

The incident has triggered sharp political exchanges, with opposition leaders demanding accountability and the ruling party asserting that the law will take its course.

Police investigations are ongoing.

#RahulGandhi #KotaNews #Congress #BJP #PoliticalControversy #DeathThreat #IndianPolitics #BreakingNews

articles.title: Ex-Husband Arrested for Brutal Murder of Software Engineer in Hyderabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 30-year-old software engineer, Sunitha, was brutally murdered at her residence in Green City Colony, Vanasthalipuram, on February 18, 2026. Police have arrested her ex-husband, Mahesh, describing the crime as a premeditated attack driven by personal resentment.

body.html:
A 30-year-old software engineer, Sunitha, was brutally murdered at her residence in Green City Colony, Vanasthalipuram, on February 18, 2026. Police have arrested her ex-husband, Mahesh, describing the crime as a premeditated attack driven by personal resentment.

The Attack:
According to investigators, Mahesh barged into Sunitha’s fourth-floor flat around noon while she was working from home. Armed with knives and a sickle, he allegedly stabbed her multiple times and later struck her head with a flower pot, killing her on the spot.

After the assault, he reportedly poured petrol inside the room and locked himself in a washroom, threatening to set the flat on fire. Neighbours and family members alerted Vanasthalipuram Police, who reached the spot and negotiated his surrender.

Background & Motive:
The couple had married in 2022 and divorced in 2024. Sunitha remarried in April 2025. Police said Mahesh was unable to accept her second marriage and allegedly blamed her for the mental distress faced by him and his family.

Officials stated that Sunitha had earlier filed a domestic violence case against Mahesh in Maharashtra. A Look-Out Circular was issued, and his passport was suspended, preventing him from returning to his IT job in Canada. He had been living in Telangana’s Peddapalli district after returning to India in March 2025.

Investigators revealed that Mahesh had been tracking Sunitha’s movements through social media and had conducted reconnaissance of her apartment in recent months. CCTV footage reportedly shows him entering the building carrying a bag containing weapons and petrol.

Pregnancy Claim:
In a complaint, Sunitha’s current husband claimed she was three months pregnant at the time of her death. Police said this has not yet been confirmed and are awaiting the post-mortem report.

The accused is currently in custody. Police said further investigation is underway to establish all aspects of planning and execution of the crime.

#JusticeForSunitha #DomesticViolenceAwareness #TrueCrime #MurderMystery #CrimeNews #WomenSafety #PremeditatedMurder #ExHusband #CCTVFootage #InvestigationUpdate

articles.title: Survey Team Attacked During Quarry Inspection in Dhar district Village
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension erupted in a village in Dhar district, Madhya Pradesh on Wednesday 18 February 2026, after villagers allegedly attacked an administrative team that had arrived to conduct drilling and sampling work for a proposed limestone quarry and cement plant project.

body.html:
Tension erupted in a village in Dhar district, Madhya Pradesh on Wednesday 18 February 2026, after villagers allegedly attacked an administrative team that had arrived to conduct drilling and sampling work for a proposed limestone quarry and cement plant project.

According to officials, the administration, accompanied by police personnel from nine police stations, reached the site to carry out survey and sampling procedures. As drilling machinery was stationed in agricultural fields, a large number of villagers — including women — gathered and began protesting. They blocked roads, sat in front of official vehicles, and refused to allow the survey to proceed.

The situation escalated rapidly. Viral videos circulating on social media show an angry mob pelting stones at government vehicles and attempting to overturn the tehsildar’s car. Several police and administrative vehicles were reportedly damaged. In view of the deteriorating law-and-order situation and to prevent injuries, officials withdrew from the site without completing the survey.

Villagers claim they have been opposing the proposed limestone mining and cement plant for months. They allege that the project would damage fertile agricultural land, deplete groundwater resources, and lead to displacement in the Kukshi, Bagh, and Jobat blocks. Protesters also referred to earlier demonstrations, including road blockades near Vijay Stambh intersection in Kukshi.

Residents further alleged that District Collector Priyanka Mishra had earlier assured them during a visit to Mogra village that no project work would proceed without consent from public representatives and villagers. They claim the current survey violated that assurance.

Sub-Divisional Magistrate Pramod Gurjar stated that sampling work was being conducted in accordance with rules. He added that objections could be submitted in writing and would be addressed at the appropriate level. Authorities confirmed that the situation has since been brought under control.

Meanwhile, Leader of Opposition Umang Singhar criticised the move, stating on social media that the rights of tribal communities over water, forest and land would be defended “from the streets to the Assembly,” and alleged that the project was being advanced without proper consent.

#Dhar #MadhyaPradesh #MiningRow #VillageProtest #LawAndOrder #BreakingNews

articles.title: Uproar at Power Substation in Lucknow, Employees Allegedly Assaulted
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension prevailed at the Vikas Nagar LESA substation in Lucknow after a woman allegedly created a ruckus and assaulted electricity department staff over a power-related issue.

body.html:
Tension prevailed at the Vikas Nagar LESA substation in Lucknow after a woman allegedly created a ruckus and assaulted electricity department staff over a power-related issue.

According to officials, a female consumer from Vikas Nagar Sector 14 had contacted the substation to report an electricity-related concern. During the call, the substation operator, identified as Anoop Kumar, asked for her electricity account number and bill details to verify the complaint. The caller reportedly became upset and disconnected the call.

Shortly thereafter, the woman allegedly arrived at the Vikas Nagar substation accompanied by a man. Officials claim the duo began abusing the staff and threatened the operator. They allegedly warned of tearing up official government documents and setting them on fire. It is further alleged that the woman asked her companion to choke the employee.

When one of the staff members began recording the incident on a mobile phone, the situation escalated, and the accused allegedly turned aggressive. Both the man and the woman are accused of physically assaulting the employee.

Departmental officials rushed to the spot after being informed. A junior engineer has reportedly filed a complaint at the police station, seeking registration of an FIR against the accused.

Police have initiated an investigation into the matter. Further action will be taken based on the complaint and available evidence.

articles.title: Drunk Man’s Arrest Sparks Roadside Scuffle with Police in Katihar; Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Despite the liquor prohibition in Bihar, a dramatic incident unfolded in Katihar, raising questions about enforcement and public conduct. The episode occurred near Panchra village under the jurisdiction of Balrampur Police Station, close to the West Bengal border.

body.html:
Despite the liquor prohibition in Bihar, a dramatic incident unfolded in Katihar, raising questions about enforcement and public conduct.

The episode occurred near Panchra village under the jurisdiction of Balrampur Police Station, close to the West Bengal border. Police detained a man allegedly found in an intoxicated condition. However, what began as a routine arrest soon escalated into a public confrontation at Bhelai Chowk.

Scuffle in the Middle of the Road

Eyewitnesses said that as soon as the man was taken into custody, his wife and daughter confronted the police team, accusing them and attempting to obstruct the arrest. The argument quickly turned into pushing and shoving, leading to a scuffle in full public view.

Videos recorded by bystanders show women pushing police personnel while a crowd gathered at the spot. Some onlookers remained spectators, while others attempted to defuse the tension.

Additional Force Deployed

As the situation intensified, additional police units were rushed to the scene. Several female police personnel were deployed, after which the situation was brought under control.

The accused was safely transported to the police station. According to sources, proceedings are being initiated against him under the Excise Act in view of Bihar’s prohibition law. Legal action is also being prepared in connection with the alleged obstruction and scuffle with police officials.

Investigation Underway

The viral video has triggered widespread discussion in the locality. Police have stated that the matter is under investigation and that the footage circulating on social media is being examined as part of the evidence.

articles.title: HDFC Bank Employee Killed in Road Accident on Dr Rajkumar Road in Bengaluru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 27-year-old employee of HDFC Bank lost her life after being struck by a speeding motorcycle on Dr Rajkumar Road in Bengaluru. Victim Identified: The deceased has been identified as Yogeshwari (27), a resident of Kempegowda Layout near Laggere. She was working at HDFC Bank in the city.

body.html:
A 27-year-old employee of HDFC Bank lost her life after being struck by a speeding motorcycle on Dr Rajkumar Road in Bengaluru.

Victim Identified:
The deceased has been identified as Yogeshwari (27), a resident of Kempegowda Layout near Laggere. She was working at HDFC Bank in the city.

The accident occurred around 12:30 pm on Monday when Yogeshwari stepped out with a colleague to collect a food parcel from a nearby eatery.

How the Accident Occurred:
According to preliminary reports, Yogeshwari and her colleague were attempting to cross Dr Rajkumar Road. While her colleague paused midway to allow traffic from one direction to pass, Yogeshwari moved ahead, apparently estimating she could cross before an approaching vehicle.

At that moment, a speeding Bullet motorcycle allegedly struck her with significant force. The impact threw her onto the road, causing severe head and bodily injuries.

She was immediately rushed to a nearby private hospital but succumbed to excessive blood loss.

Rider Injured:
The motorcycle rider, identified as Deepan (21), also fell during the collision and sustained injuries. He is currently undergoing treatment at a private hospital.

Police Action:
The Rajajinagar Traffic Police conducted a spot inspection and registered a case. The body has been shifted to Victoria Hospital for post-mortem examination.

Preliminary investigation suggests overspeeding as the primary cause of the accident. Authorities are continuing their probe to determine all contributing factors.

Yogeshwari’s sudden death has left her family, colleagues, and local community in deep mourning.

#Bengaluru #RoadAccident #DrRajkumarRoad #HDFCBank #Rajajinagar #TrafficPolice #Karnataka #BreakingNews

articles.title: Elderly Woman’s Mangalsutra Snatched in Tumakuru; CCTV Captures Accused
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A chain-snatching incident has been reported from the Kyathasandra area of Tumakuru, where an elderly woman was targeted early in the morning while opening her petty shop. Incident on Maidala Road The incident took place on February 15 at around 6:30 a.m.

body.html:
A chain-snatching incident has been reported from the Kyathasandra area of Tumakuru, where an elderly woman was targeted early in the morning while opening her petty shop.

Incident on Maidala Road

The incident took place on February 15 at around 6:30 a.m. on Maidala Road in the Kyathasandra locality. The victim, identified as Parvathamma, runs a small petty shop in the area.

According to reports, a man approached her shop under the pretext of purchasing a cigarette. As Parvathamma turned to hand it over, the accused suddenly grabbed her mangalsutra chain and pulled it forcefully.

The chain snapped due to the sudden jerk, and the accused managed to flee with only half of the broken chain.

Victim Injured During Struggle

Startled by the attack, Parvathamma screamed for help and attempted to chase the accused. However, the force of the snatching caused her to lose balance and fall. Despite her efforts, the accused escaped from the scene.

CCTV Footage and Police Action

The entire episode was captured on a nearby CCTV camera. The footage reportedly shows the suspect entering the shop, asking for a cigarette, and then abruptly snatching the chain before running away.

A complaint has been registered at Kyathasandra Police Station. Police have initiated a case and are reviewing CCTV footage to identify and trace the accused. Investigations are ongoing in nearby areas.

Authorities have stated that efforts are underway to apprehend the suspect at the earliest.

articles.title: Female Lawyer, Women Clash Publicly on Railway Road in Hapur; Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic altercation broke out on Railway Road in the City Kotwali area of Hapur, where a female lawyer and several women were involved in a public scuffle despite the presence of police personnel.

body.html:
A dramatic altercation broke out on Railway Road in the City Kotwali area of Hapur, where a female lawyer and several women were involved in a public scuffle despite the presence of police personnel.

Incident Details:
According to reports, a woman from Bulandshahr had arrived at the spot along with her family members and a police team to inspect a location linked to an ongoing court case. During the visit, an argument reportedly erupted between the visiting party and a female lawyer representing the accused side.

The verbal dispute quickly escalated into a physical confrontation. Eyewitnesses said the women began pushing, slapping, and kicking each other in full public view, turning the busy street into a chaotic scene. A large crowd gathered as the altercation intensified.

Viral Video:
A bystander recorded the entire incident on a mobile phone. The footage, now circulating widely on social media, shows the women engaging in physical violence while police personnel attempt to manage the situation. The video has triggered public debate, with many questioning the breakdown of law and order in the presence of law enforcement.

Police Response:
Police have taken cognizance of the viral video and initiated an inquiry into the incident. Officials stated that action will be taken based on formal complaints and findings from the investigation.

Further details are awaited as authorities continue to examine the circumstances that led to the confrontation.

articles.title: Former BJYM Leader Sonu Rathore Shot, Stabbed in Kanpur; Bajrang Dal Functionary Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kanpur witnessed a violent attack late on February 18, 2026, when Sonu Rathore, former district vice president of the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM), was brutally assaulted near Chhapera Pulia under the limits of Rawatpur Police Station.

body.html:
Kanpur witnessed a violent attack late on February 18, 2026, when Sonu Rathore, former district vice president of the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM), was brutally assaulted near Chhapera Pulia under the limits of Rawatpur Police Station.

According to police, Rathore was returning from a wedding when he was intercepted on the road. He was allegedly beaten, stabbed multiple times — reportedly seven to eight times — and shot in the back.

Police Action

Rawatpur police received information late Tuesday night about a clash and gunfire near Chhapera Puliya bridge. A police team rushed to the spot and found Rathore seriously injured. He was immediately shifted to Hallett Hospital (LLR Hospital) for treatment.

Police identified the main accused as Abhishek Vishwakarma, reportedly a functionary associated with Bajrang Dal. He was arrested within an hour of the incident following a raid at his residence.

Motive and Investigation

Preliminary investigation indicates that the attack stemmed from a long-standing personal enmity, reportedly linked to a dispute over a shop.

Deputy Commissioner of Police (West) S. M. Kasim Abidi stated that a case has been registered based on a written complaint from the victim’s side and further legal action is underway.

Current Condition

Rathore is currently admitted to the ICU. While earlier reports described his condition as critical, doctors after preliminary treatment stated that he is presently out of immediate danger.

Further investigation into the incident is ongoing.

#Kanpur #UttarPradesh #SonuRathore #BJYM #BajrangDal #Rawatpur #CrimeNews #PoliceAction #BreakingNews
